title: How to find keyword opportunties with Keyword Overview in Moz Pro

hook.text: Today, we're diving into one of your most powerful tools for keyword research, the keyword overview section in Moz's Keyword Explorer. In just a few minutes, I'll show you how to uncover golden insights about any keyword you're targeting.
hook.technique_other: agenda/benefit promise read over a static branded title card ('Find Keywords Fast!') with an animated 'Voiced by AI' waveform badge

cta.text: Learn more on the Moz Help Hub at moz.com/help; get started with the freemium Keyword Explorer or sign up for a free trial; subscribe for more SEO tips.

summary.tone: Friendly, upbeat how-to tutorial with an AI-generated voice. Second-person and instructional, with casual 'gold' metaphors ('golden insights', 'two gold mines', 'pure gold'). The flat-illustrated brand cards bookend a plain product walkthrough.

signature_moments.description: Throughout the long walkthrough, the camera zooms in on each UI element as the VO names it. An orange outline draws on around the target, and a small illustrated sticker pops beside it (calendar for Monthly Volume, a character for Difficulty, a gem for the 'two gold mines').
signature_moments.why_premium: Tying camera moves and highlights to the spoken words turns a raw screen capture into a guided demo. The viewer always knows where to look, and the stickers add brand personality without hiding the real UI.

signature_moments.description: Every section change uses the same layered wipe of staggered full-height brand-colour panels: title to demo, demo to end card, and the free-tool page to the subscribe card.
signature_moments.why_premium: One repeated, on-brand transition makes the separate pieces feel like a designed system instead of spliced clips. It is cheap to build but reads as deliberate.

signature_moments.description: On the opening title card, a purple audio-waveform badge with a robot mascot animates with the voice-over and openly labels the narration 'Voiced by AI'.
signature_moments.why_premium: It gives a static card live motion that follows the audio, and it is open about the AI voice instead of hiding it.

hook.evidence: The opening is a generic 'Today we're diving into...' agenda line over a static title card that holds for 10.8 s. There is no stat, question, pain point or early product shot, and the UI first appears only at about 11.8 s.

clarity.evidence: The walkthrough is linear and step by step: navigate, type a keyword, Analyze, then each metric, suggestions, SERP analysis and a pro tip. Zoom-ins and orange highlight boxes land on each element as the VO names it, and the example query stays the same throughout.

ui_showcase.evidence: It uses the real product UI in a framed inset card, with eased camera zooms, highlight boxes and a cursor-driven expand of the AI Overview preview. However, the UI is shown as a raw capture with no recreated or simplified panels, the free-tool segment is just a static hold and a plain scroll, and dense table text is unreadable at frame size.

motion_polish.evidence: The panel wipes are clean and consistent, but most of the video is either static cards (s001, s005 and s008 hold for 10.8 s, 10.4 s and about 9.5 s) or a continuous screen capture with basic zooms and a plain scroll. There is no kinetic type, layered element animation or spring motion.

sound_design.evidence: Judged from anchors plus visuals. A music bed at about 117 BPM is detected, and integrated loudness is -17.89 LUFS. All 10 SFX candidates (x001-x010) fall in the last 11 s (114.3-121.6 s, the s007/s008 outro), and most are labelled unsure or music, so the demo clicks, zooms and highlight pops appear to have no sound effects synced to them.

vo_script_quality.evidence: The AI-voiced script is clear, concise and well paced to the actions, with good second-person instructions and a pro tip. It leans on clichés ('golden insights', 'gold mines', 'pure gold'), and the transcript repeats 'strategy.' (w82-w83), which could be a voice artifact.

brand_consistency.evidence: The opening and both end cards share the same flat style: blue blob, yellow arc, MOZ wordmark, slab-serif type and ornaments. Every transition is a brand-blue panel wipe, and every UI shot sits in the same rounded card on the purple-to-blue gradient.

works_muted.evidence: There are no captions. Muted, a viewer sees the title, the highlighted UI elements and the end-card text, but every explanation of what a metric means and why it matters is in the VO only, and the CTA details (free tool, free trial) are spoken.

overall.evidence: A competent, well-branded product tutorial: clear guided walkthrough, consistent panel-wipe system and cards. Held back by a weak static hook, long static holds, minimal motion craft, no SFX in the demo, and full dependence on the voice-over.

localization_friendliness.notes: Card text is short and could be swapped (title, Help Hub line and URL, subscribe line), and because the narration is AI-generated, re-voicing is cheap. However, the walkthrough is an English product capture whose example query, labels and tables are baked into the recording, and the meaning depends almost entirely on the VO, with no captions.

annotation.what_happens: Static flat-vector title card: a large blue blob with a yellow arc stroke, small dots and asterisk sparkles holds the MOZ wordmark and title; in the first ~1 s a tilted light card slides in at lower right, a dark pill bar extends from left to right and the robot mascot circle appears, then a purple audio waveform above the pill animates with the voice-over for the rest of the shot (w0-w38). Around 10.5 s a blue vertical panel enters from the right edge, starting the wipe into s002.
annotation.build_rebuild: Render a static SVG title layout (blue blob, yellow arc, sparkles, wordmark, two-line slab-serif title), then at t=0.2-1.0 s slide in a rotated badge card from the right and scale a dark pill from scaleX 0 to 1 with ease-out, pop in a circular mascot avatar, and drive a row of ~40 thin purple bars' heights from the voice-over amplitude envelope until the outgoing wipe.

annotation.focal_element: Full-frame flat colour panels (light blue, dark navy, mid navy) sweeping across, then a purple-to-blue horizontal gradient
annotation.transition_other: layered colour-panel wipe: stacked brand-colour vertical panels slide in from the right over the title card
annotation.what_happens: One-second graphic transition with no text: solid vertical bands in brand blues slide horizontally across the full frame (at 11.0 s light blue, dark navy and mid navy bands are visible side by side; the keyframe shows a darker band at left over mid navy), and by 11.5 s a purple-to-light-blue left-to-right gradient sweeps in behind a remaining navy band. VO 'Let's jump right in' (w39-w41) starts during it.
annotation.build_rebuild: Build a 1 s transition of three or four full-height solid-colour rectangles in brand blues that translateX from 100% to -100% with staggered starts (~80 ms apart) and ease-in-out, followed by a purple-to-light-blue linear-gradient layer that slides in last and reveals the next scene.

annotation.focal_element: Moz Keyword Explorer results page shown as an inset rounded white card on a purple-to-blue gradient; in the final stretch the SERP Analysis table with the AI Overview row and its expand arrow under the cursor

SERP Analysis for "how to give my dog a haircut"
annotation.typography: All text is native product UI: a clean humanist sans (low-confidence guess: Lato), semibold sentence-case section headings with quoted keyword, regular-weight small labels and table headers, pill-shaped chips with small medium-weight labels, normal tracking. No added captions or kinetic type. Bubble-chart chip labels and table body text are too small to quote reliably and are omitted.
annotation.what_happens: Long (85.6 s) narrated screen-recording walkthrough of the Keyword Overview page inside a rounded card framed by a purple-to-blue gradient. I only saw sheets 13-15 (84.0-97.0 s) and the mid-shot keyframe. The keyframe shows the Keyword Suggestions area with Top suggestions and Questions bubble clusters and an added faceted 3D gem graphic between them, matching the 'two gold mines' line (w157-w161). From 84.0 s, for the pro tip (w249-w256) the cursor moves to the small arrow beside the AI Overview chip in the SERP Analysis table; a click-ripple shows around 85.0 s, and by 85.5 s an 'AI Overview Text Preview' panel with a summary paragraph and three source links has expanded under the row (w257-w269). The view then holds almost still with the cursor on the arrow while the VO wraps up (w270-w296), until 97.4 s.
annotation.build_rebuild: Show a 1:1 screen capture of the product page inside a rounded-corner white card at about 90% frame width over a left-to-right purple-to-light-blue linear gradient, move a large hand cursor along an eased path to the target arrow, fire a 300 ms expanding ring at the click, and open the preview panel below the row with a height expand.

annotation.focal_element: Full-height solid vertical colour bands (pale blue, bright blue, dark navy, mid navy) sweeping across the frame
annotation.transition_other: layered colour-panel wipe: stacked brand-colour vertical panels slide horizontally over the UI scene (same device as s002)
annotation.what_happens: A 0.43 s graphic transition with no text. The keyframe shows a purple strip at the far left (the last edge of the gradient frame) being covered by pale blue, bright blue, dark navy and mid navy vertical bands. By 97.5 s a bright blue band sits at the left over dark and mid navy. The VO line 'in just two minutes' (w294-w296) plays over it. The same panel-wipe device bridged s001 to s002.
annotation.build_rebuild: Reuse the s002 transition: four full-height solid rectangles in brand blues translate horizontally across the frame with staggered starts (~60-80 ms) and ease-in-out over ~0.45 s, revealing the end card underneath.

Its hero image shows a glowing wireframe brain and a translucent key, and below sits the keyword form ('pet groomers', United States locale, a Cloudflare 'Success!' check, a Find keywords button). No added captions. The lock-panel message is partly cut off by the card edge, and the lower table rows and blurred panel content are too small or blurred to read.
annotation.what_happens: Hard cut at 110.93 s to the same landing page lower down: at 111.0 s the 'Preview the power of Keyword Explorer' form with 'pet groomers' entered sits above the top of the results. From about 111.0 s to 113.0 s the page scrolls up smoothly inside the inset card, past 'Showing results for pet groomers' and the Volume (6.3k), Organic CTR (41%) and Difficulty (50, Moderate) cards, to the Keyword Suggestions area: a Top Suggestions table on the left and a blurred panel with a padlock and a Moz Pro Free Trial upsell on the right. The scroll settles around 113.5 s and holds while the VO says 'sign up for a free trial to access premium features' (w337-w346). At about 114.5 s a pale teal panel and a dark navy band enter from the right edge, starting the wipe into s008.
annotation.build_rebuild: Inside the same rounded-corner card (~85% frame width) on the purple-to-light-blue gradient, translateY a tall full-page screenshot of the results page upward by roughly one viewport over ~2 s with ease-in-out, hold it ~1.5 s, then slide full-height teal and navy rectangles in from the right edge to begin the panel wipe.
